metadata.title: EOS MCP Dead, Orphan, and Simulation Tools Register
metadata.summary: 22 tools operate as theatrical simulations returning mock SHA-256 hashes without performing physical work; 1 tool is hardcoded as NOT_CONFIGURED.

simulation_tools.name: eos.pleroma.jubilee
simulation_tools.actual_implementation: Computes mock bytesPurged = 1024 * octaves.size and returns sha256-JUBILEE hash
simulation_tools.why_simulation: Returns generated SHA-256 hash or mock JSON without executing external commands, network calls, SQLite FTS5, MicroVMs, CodeQL, or thermal throttling.
simulation_tools.recommendation: Segregate into isolated simulation testbed or prune from production MCP registry.
